version_scope: Official public legacy browser build, not latest Steam.
mode: Sandbox; actual browser input, unmodified runtime. Spawn buttons and camera WASD used.

first_cast.interpretation: Consistent with independently read 200 actual travel / 250 hint radius. Screen estimates about ±2 px; not direct original-world-coordinate telemetry.

cooldown.observed: B does not enter targeting at first two attempts; ring returns on third. Capture begins slightly after the cast and state read. This brackets readiness, does not independently establish exactly 8 simulation seconds.
cooldown.sandbox_caveat: Sandbox targeting applies tactical time-scale 0.35 and ramps back; no exact simulation timer was recorded.

mixed_selection.selection: Two wraiths and one friendly swordsman, selected by actual box drag.
mixed_selection.observed: B enters aim although ability button is hidden. Both wraiths relocate toward the common click along their own directions; friendly swordsman remains at previous footpoint.

far_target.observed: Target beyond the range gate does not relocate casters and keeps targeting active. Exact 300 world-unit boundary is source-derived/local-tested, not measured from this click.

melee_attempt.observed: One selected wraith walks toward three newly spawned enemy draugrs, engages nearest; scythe animation and later wraith death visible.
melee_attempt.limits: Enemies not arranged within controlled 50-radius/90-degree arc; no numeric HP readout. Not an independent measurement of cleave damage, angle, fire time or splash count.

native_probe.engine: Official Mac exported 4.6 binary prints help; rejects --path override before external probe runs.
native_probe.extension: Package unit_physics.gdextension declares Windows/Web targets, no macOS mapping.
native_probe.result: No original native combat execution established. Browser sandbox used instead.

local_correspondence.added_scope: Real friendly capable/incapable mixed selection, independent distance clamp and untouched ordinary ally.
local_correspondence.prior_checks: 45 input/FPS + 696 regression from wraith/validation.json; not rerun for this test-only addition.

remaining: Exact original cleave and obstacle landing, native Float32/hash/RNG, latest Steam, remaining units/siege/navigation lifecycle/performance/audio/final delivery remain open.
